verdict.rationale: Ellis Porter is an immigration law firm offering attorney-led petition drafting, filing, and compliance services, plus a client document portal. It is not an AI agent or tool-using software product, so acting as an MCP client that plugs in servers to use their tools is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any agent or MCP-client capability that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
